title: Audit activity archive: granular search, export formats, and saved presets in Console
creator: Maya Chen
description: Enable a production-ready audit activity viewer in the Console that supports field-level query building, performant cursor pagination, multi-format export (CSV, NDJSON), and saved query presets. This ticket covers the end-to-end work to ship a usable experience for administrators and security engineers: backend query & export APIs, RBAC enforcement for export/save actions, front-end search builder and results UX, and operational safeguards for large exports.
acceptance_criteria: Console: users with audit:read can run queries; users with audit:export can download results
Filter builder supports actor, action, resource, outcome, IP, user_agent, auth_provider (SAML/IdP), and time range
Pagination uses cursor-based tokens and preserves sort stability across pages
Exports are available as streamed CSV and NDJSON; exported fields & column order documented
Saved presets: user-scoped and org-scoped presets with rename, delete, and share-to-team flows
PII redaction rules applied to exports (emails and session tokens redacted) and audit trail of export operations recorded
Large result sets (>100k rows) trigger async export job with progress UI and email/download link
All API endpoints include tracing hooks and surface metrics for query latency and rows scanned
Automated tests cover RBAC enforcement, pagination correctness, export integrity, and saved preset lifecycle
tasks: Backend: design query API schema for complex filters and cursor tokens
Backend: implement optimized index scan and query planner for common audit predicates
Backend: streaming export endpoint that supports CSV and NDJSON; ensure memory-safe streaming
Backend: async export job with S3 upload + temporary signed URL for large exports
Backend: enforce RBAC v2 checks on read/export/save endpoints and record export audit event
Backend: redact sensitive fields per compliance config (configurable mask rules)
Frontend: filter/query builder component (field suggestions, quick time ranges)
Frontend: results table with cursor pagination, row-level expand for full event JSON
Frontend: export modal with format options, column selector, and size estimate
Frontend: saved presets CRUD UI and org-sharing flow
QA: load test typical queries and export paths; validate latency & memory behavior
Docs: write Console help, API doc, and runbook for handling high-volume exports
notes: Decision: use cursor-based pagination to avoid expensive OFFSET scans for large datasets; cursor encodes (timestamp, tiebreaker, event_id)
Trade-off: NDJSON chosen over wrapped JSON arrays to allow streaming consumers to process events incrementally
Constraint: self-serve exports are limited to 100k rows to protect cluster resources; larger requests use async export queue with quotas
Security: export endpoints must log exporter identity and originating IP; these export records are retained per retention policy and accessible by Compliance team
Indexing: adding a composite index on (timestamp DESC, actor_id, action) reduced 30-day query median from 3.2s to 0.9s on spike tests
Redaction: initial mask rules redact any field matching /email|token|session/i; future work to add consent-based selective disclosure
SSO/SAML: include idp_session_id and saml_assertion_id in schema so Security can correlate console activity with IdP logs
